GENESIS "Creates life where there is nothing. Builds ships. Conquers worlds."
A self-sufficient mothership that can travel to any planet and requires only Nauvis and Vulcanus technology to build. No railgun turrets, no fusion energy, no stack inserters required. Just iron, copper, steel and the fires of Vulcanus.

GENESIS was designed with one philosophy: everything you need to conquer a new planet should travel with you, not wait for you on a planet you haven't reached yet.

📌 Note: GENESIS includes 15 electromagnetic plants and 2 cryogenic plants in its full legendary version. If you haven't visited Fulgora or Aquilo yet, these can be temporarily replaced with assembling machines and/or chemical plants until you unlock them. The ship will function correctly either way — and that is the point.
📊 SPECIFICATIONS Cruise speed: ~270 km/s Energy: Nuclear Technology required: Nauvis + Vulcanus only Blueprint version: Full legendary ✅ Compatible with: Nauvis, Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba, Aquilo ❌ NOT compatible with: Edge of the solar system and the Shattered Planet
🏭 PRODUCTION

The ship produces in bulk and stores ready-to-use:

Iron plates, copper plates and steel bars Low Density Structures, blue circuits and rocket fuel — everything needed to launch rockets on demand Space platform foundations — because GENESIS doesn't just visit new planets, it builds new ships to send there All four tiers of modules — speed, productivity, efficiency and quality modules, all three levels, manufactured entirely from scratch aboard the ship
🌍 PLANETARY INPUTS

GENESIS is self-sufficient but not isolated. To unlock its full potential, it requests a small number of resources from the planets it visits:

Nauvis → Nuclear fuel Vulcanus → Legendary stone, for legendary concrete and construction materials Gleba → Legendary spoilage used as ingredients in advanced module production Fulgora → Legendary superconductor Aquilo → nothing

These inputs are minimal and optional — GENESIS operates without them, but with them it reaches its full legendary production capacity. Every planet you conquer feeds the machine that conquers the next one.
⭐ LEGENDARY MALL

At the heart of GENESIS is a full legendary quality mall that autonomously manufactures and stores a complete stack of every item needed to build a new ship or establish a new colony, organized by category:

🔫 Defense Gun turrets, laser turrets

🚀 Space Platform Asteroid collectors, thrusters, crushers, cargo bays, space platform foundations

🏗️ Production Assembling machines mk3, chemical plants, pumpjack, Oil refinery, electric furnace

🤖 Inserters Long-handed inserters, fast inserters, bulk inserters

📦 Logistics & Storage Passive provider chests, requester chests, storage chests, buffer chests, storage tanks, roboports, construction robots, logistic robots

⚡ Power Solar panels, accumulators, medium electric poles, large electric poles, substations, steam turbines, Nuclear reactor, heat pipes, heat exchanger

🚂 Transport & Trains Locomotives, cargo wagons, fluid wagons

🔬 Modules Speed modules 1/2/3, productivity modules 1/2/3, efficiency modules 1/2/3, quality modules 1/2/3

🏛️ Structures Beacons, radars

Every item. Always ready. Always with you. No more rockets needed and no more extra trips.
⚛️ NUCLEAR SELF-SUFFICIENCY

GENESIS runs entirely on nuclear power with a fully integrated uranium enrichment and nuclear waste recycling system. It produces its own fuel and recycles its own spent cells, significantly reducing external dependency.

⚠️ Important — Uranium fuel cells: While GENESIS produces its own nuclear fuel cells through onboard enrichment, production alone is not sufficient to fully sustain the reactor at cruising speed. It is recommended to regularly supply additional uranium fuel cells via rocket from your planet-side production to keep the ship running optimally on long journeys.

⚠️ Important — First Launch: Before departure, manually insert a small amount of ice into the ship to ensure the nuclear system has a minimum water supply for correct startup. The reactors will not initialize properly without it. Once running, the ship manages its own water supply autonomously.
📋 IMPORTANT NOTES

📌 Quality note: GENESIS operates in full legendary quality, but asteroid collectors must be at least uncommon quality or above to ensure correct asteroid collection rates. Normal quality collectors may not be sufficient to sustain the ship's production.

📌 No rocket turrets yet? Without rocket turrets, do NOT travel to Aquilo — the large asteroids there require them and the ship will take heavy damage without them. However, GENESIS handles the inner planets (Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba) perfectly without rocket turrets. Conquer those first, unlock the technology and then set course for Aquilo.

📌 REMEMBER: GENESIS CAN BE BUILT HAVING ONLY VISITED NAUVIS AND VULCANUS. You do not need Fulgora, Gleba or Aquilo technology to launch this ship. It was born from iron, copper and lava — and that is enough to begin conquering the stars.
💡 WHY GENESIS?

Because it is the origin of everything that comes after. Every new ship, every new colony, every new planet conquered — it all starts here. You don't need a planet to build from. You don't need a factory back home. You carry the factory with you.

The planets give you resources. GENESIS turns them into power.

Build it once. Conquer forever.
